title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.36874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. translated_title: AdaGround：面向GUI定位的令牌归一化自适应缩放与验证器在环细化方法
translated_abstract: GUI（图形用户界面）定位在高分辨率屏幕上的失败大多发生在小目标上，而放大画面是一种常见的免训练补救措施。然而，大多数现有的缩放流水线无法使缩放倍率与目标大小相匹配，会无条件接受缩放后的答案，且从不重新审视错误的答案。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AdaGround，一个包含三个组件的免训练框架：（1）令牌归一化自适应缩放，根据模型自身对目标大小的估计，为每个样本设定放大倍率、视野和缩放深度；（2）验证器在环细化，利用一个标记点击式的“是/否”验证器来保留或拒绝每次缩放、在缩放链之间做出选择、触发重新定位，并通过存在性查询决定何时弃权；（3）组合式结构定位，根据表头组合推导出电子表格单元格。在Qwen3-VL模型上，AdaGround超越了最先进的免训练缩放方法以及许多经过训练的模型。
tldr: AdaGround提出了一种免训练的GUI定位框架，通过依据目标大小自适应设定缩放参数、引入“是/否”验证器在环机制甄别并修正缩放结果、以及根据表头组合定位电子表格单元格，在高分辨率屏幕小目标定位上超越了现有最先进的免训练方法。
en_tdlr: AdaGround is a training-free GUI grounding framework that adaptively sets zoom magnification based on the model's estimate of target size, employs a Yes/No verifier-in-the-loop to validate, refine, or abstain from zoomed answers, and composes spreadsheet cells from headers, surpassing state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods on high-resolution screens.
